selection.caption: Hands shape a lump of clay-like bread dough into a smooth, round boule on a wooden table.
selection.selection: VP027 is one of two Joint losses with fixed-anchor routing, selected from completed paired scores to inspect the PC-versus-SA tradeoff. One diagnostic case, not a prevalence estimate.

review_method: Actual inspection of the paired8-frame panel. No synthetic imagery.

observations.normal: Known first frame has hands and dough. They persist at sampled frame11 but are absent by frame22; later video is dominated by repeated brown/grey texture. Raw scoresSA4/PC4 do not capture this prolonged content failure.
observations.anchor_routing: From sampled frame11 onward the image is almost black/dark brown, with a horizontal seam and faint repeating texture. Hands/dough are absent. RawPC5 is not evidence of successful kneading physics. SA2 correctly signals weak request fulfillment.

decision: Do not adopt anchor routing for itsPC4.5625 mean. The full16 SA/Joint regression and this actual failure support keeping the learned route while revising fusion. Normal R11B also remains rejected despite its per-caseSA4/PC4.
next: Inspect evaluator frame loading/path provenance to distinguish an evaluation-pipeline defect from model-scoring limitations. Preserve original ratings and videos.
